s273: A section of road on which vehicles must have anti-skid (snow) chains fitted to at least two drive wheels.

Signs that allow a turn from the leftmost lane also allow a U-turn from that lane.
Signs placed before an intersection apply to the whole intersection, unless other signs 5.15.1 and 5.15.2 placed at it give different instructions;
The signs do not apply to route vehicles.
s305: Shows the start of an additional uphill lane or of a deceleration lane at a junction or crossing. If sign 4.6 "Minimum speed limit" is shown on sign 5.15.3 placed before the additional lane, a driver who cannot continue in the main lane at the indicated speed or faster must move into the additional lane.

s315: Marks a tram stop and a taxi rank.

s339: Marks an area within which parking is regulated or the maximum speed is limited, as shown. The sign is placed at every entrance to the area.

s382: Shows the length of the U-turn zone. The sign is placed in front of or above the U-turn place, or in advance with plate 8.1.1. The sign does not allow a left turn.

s394: A road with no through exit. The sign is placed before the junction with the road that has no through exit.
s396: Shows the route to take at an intersection where certain manoeuvres are prohibited, or the permitted directions of travel at a complex intersection. The sign is placed immediately before the intersection.
s398: Shows the recommended direction for trucks, tractors and self-propelled machines when they are prohibited from going in one of the directions at an intersection. The signs are placed at the start of the recommended route, before the intersection or 100−150 metres before it.

s412: Shows the type of vehicle to which the sign applies.

s479: Separates traffic flows moving in opposite directions and marks the boundaries of lanes on hazardous sections; marks the edges of the carriageway that may not be entered; marks the boundaries of parking places and the edges of the carriageway on roads that, by their traffic conditions, are not motorways. s497: Marks a place where parking is prohibited; used on its own or together with sign 3.28; drawn at the edge of the carriageway or on top of the kerb.
s499: Separates traffic flows moving in opposite or the same directions on a section of road where changing lanes is allowed from only one lane; marks U-turn places, exits from and entrances to parking areas, etc., where traffic is allowed in one direction only. s513: Marks traffic islands where traffic flows divide or merge.
